name: PSA

reduction.description: reduction factor for SE blocks; default 4

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, channel, reduction=4, S=4):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    ci = channel // S
    convs = nn.ModuleList()
    for i in range(S):
        ks = 2 * (i + 1) + 1
        pad = i + 1
        convs.append(nn.Conv2d(ci, ci, kernel_size=ks, padding=pad))
    se_blocks = nn.ModuleList()
    for _ in range(S):
        se_blocks.append(nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(ci, ci // reduction, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(ci // reduction, ci, kernel_size=1, bias=False),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        ))
    convs = convs.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    se_blocks = se_blocks.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    SPC_out = x.view(b, S, -1, h, w).clone()
    for idx, conv in enumerate(convs):
        SPC_out[:, idx, :, :, :] = conv(SPC_out[:, idx, :, :, :])
    se_outs = []
    for idx, se in enumerate(se_blocks):
        group = SPC_out[:, idx, :, :, :]
        pooled = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(group, 1)
        se_out = se(pooled)
        se_outs.append(se_out)
    SE_out = torch.stack(se_outs, dim=1)
    SE_out = SE_out.expand_as(SPC_out)
    softmax_out = F.softmax(SE_out, dim=1)
    PSA_out = SPC_out * softmax_out
    PSA_out = PSA_out.view(b, -1, h, w)
    return PSA_out
